Selected academic work

Projects & research.

A selection of valuation, modeling, banking analysis and development proposal work completed in 2026.

01 / Equity research⌁

Equity Research & Financial Modeling

Built an integrated three-statement model using 2018–2025 historical financials, forecasting key drivers through 2030 under Base, Bull and Bear scenarios. Estimated intrinsic value through FCFF DCF and cross-checked with comparable-company multiples.

Three-statement modelFCFF DCFWACCSensitivity analysis
View project ↗
02 / Portfolio strategy◫

Equity Valuation & Portfolio Optimization

Valued DSE-listed companies across FMCG, pharmaceuticals, telecom and banking using multiple valuation methods. Simulated 10,000 portfolio allocations, plotted the Efficient Frontier and identified Minimum Variance and Optimal Portfolios.

DDM & FCFEP/E & P/BEfficient FrontierOptimization
View project ↗
03 / Banking analysis▥

Bank Financial Performance & Risk Analysis

Analyzed 12 years of The City Bank Limited's profitability, asset quality, liquidity and capital adequacy. Assessed market valuation using Tobin's Q and estimated OLS models linking profitability with financial and macroeconomic factors.

ROA · ROE · NIMNPL · CARLCR · NSFRTobin's Q · OLS
View project ↗
04 / Development proposal✳

Childcare Access for RMG Workers

Designed an 18-month proposal to expand affordable childcare for low-income RMG working parents in Gazipur. The financially sustainable model combines subsidized micro-fees, factory co-financing and public-private partnerships.

Theory of ChangeSWOTLogframeSDGs 1, 4, 5 & 8
